instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium full shot. On a sunny rooftop under a blue sky, a group of friends interacts. In the center, the grey-haired man (R2) in a grey t-shirt and the red-haired woman (R1) in a white t-shirt sit looking at each other and smiling. On the left, the man in the black hat (R4) in a brown shirt and red bandana stands talking to the Asian woman (R5), who gestures back. On the right, the Black man (R6) in a dark blue shirt stands looking down at the seated pair. Bright daylight casts warm natural tones across the scene.
elements: R4 is the one standing and talking to R5 while R5 gestures back
R6 stands looking down at the seated pair R1 and R2
R1 and R2 sit facing each other and smiling
R4 and R5 interact with R4 speaking and R5 responding by gesture
the group is on a sunny rooftop under a blue sky
